name: Cuppacumbalong Pottery

name: Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve
reason: obvious draw: ACT's second park, named by Wikivoyage ('a must-see'), VisitCanberra and the ACT parks agency; wildlife sanctuary, walks, rock shelter (opened Wikivoyage Tuggeranong page); entry fee about $11 per vehicle
objection: Overlaps with its many walk candidates, which I reject as parts of it; it is a feature/area but clearly a place to go.

name: Tidbinbilla Visitor Centre
reason: part of Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve (entry point with maps, gift shop, displays), not a separate draw
objection: It has displays and live animal exhibits, but they are the reserve's.

name: Birrigai Time Trail
reason: Wikivoyage names a 3 km flat walk from the visitor centre to the Birrigai rock shelter (artefacts over 25,000 years old), a distinct Aboriginal heritage walk; I keep this as the trail and treat the shelter as its end. Single counted source seen.
objection: Against: one source, inside Tidbinbilla (already kept), and Wikivoyage's own claim of 'world's oldest inhabited rock shelter' is unverified. For: it is the reserve's one cultural-heritage visit and a guide singles it out.

name: Birrigai Rock Shelter
reason: duplicate of Birrigai Time Trail (its end point); the shelter is reached only by that walk and sits inside Tidbinbilla
objection: If the shelter is the real draw, it could replace the trail entry; either way only one belongs.

name: Gibraltar Peak
reason: a named peak with two counted sources (Wikivoyage, VisitCanberra attraction page which I opened): 8.2 km, 2-3 hour climb to panoramic views; a separate place from the reserve and distinct from its other walks
objection: It is a hard walk inside Tidbinbilla and may be judged part of the reserve; but peaks named by a source are kept per the run rule.

name: Camels Hump
reason: part of Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve (one trail); only a VisitCanberra PDF names it, which I could not read for it, and the candidate's coordinates point at Mount Macedon (Victoria)
objection: If it is a notable lookout it could return, but nothing here proves it.

name: Sanctuary Loop
reason: part of Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve: a 2.5 km wheelchair-accessible loop through its wildlife sanctuary, already the reserve's headline draw
objection: Wikivoyage calls it one of the best wildlife trails; but the wildlife is the reserve's reason to visit and the loop is not a separate place.

name: Church Rock Heritage Loop
reason: part of Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve: a short loop past ruins; single source, nothing named to see beyond 'remnants'
objection: Late 19th-century ruins are history interest; thin.

name: Turkey Hill Trail
reason: part of Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve: a 500 m, 15-minute climb, too short to be a distinct draw
objection: Granite boulders and views are real, but it is a minor lookout walk.

name: Congwarra Trail
reason: part of Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve: family trail to a playground
objection: A pleasant hour walk, but nothing distinct.

name: Honeysuckle Creek Tracking Station
reason: Wikivoyage Namadgi page (opened) names the Apollo tracking station as a place to go: NASA site that televised the moon landing, with information on what stood there; high public interest (9,289 views)
objection: Not much of the station remains (the dish was moved), so it is mostly signage; single counted source.

name: Orroral Valley Tracking Station
reason: Wikivoyage Namadgi page lists the former NASA Earth station on Orroral Rd and it starts the Orroral Valley Circuit; single counted source
objection: For: a space-history stop in the same valley as Orroral Homestead. Against: ruins with little to see, one source, short visit.

name: Gibraltar Falls
reason: two counted sources (Wikivoyage twice, opened): one of the ACT's largest waterfalls, 50 m drop, lookout and picnic area; Wikivoyage says travellers visit it as a destination in its own right
objection: It lies within Namadgi and the waterfall flow is seasonal.

name: Namadgi Visitor Centre
reason: an information centre for Namadgi National Park (maps and park information), not a distinct draw; the park is the place
objection: Wikivoyage describes it as an information stop only with hours, and it offers some displays.
